description: This file contains utility methods for managing scheduler operations in the OpenMRS platform, including starting up, shutting down, sending error reports via email, and calculating the next execution time for scheduled tasks.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Initializes and starts the scheduler service using provided properties, including updating default credentials and managing privileges.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the scheduler service by invoking its onShutdown method, handling potential exceptions.

methods.name: sendSchedulerError
methods.description: Sends an email with system information and exception details if email notifications are enabled.

methods.name: getExceptionAsString
methods.description: Converts a Throwable's stack trace into a string representation.

methods.name: getNextExecution
methods.description: Calculates the next execution time for a scheduled task based on its start time and repeat interval.
